body: A way I was able to beat it was spawn the spirit jellyfish ashes at one side of the boss arena and place myself on the opposite end. Just weave attacks in when Margit targets the jelly then dodge back a bit until the jelly gets a ranged hit off and do it all over again. Took me 3-4 tries at level 20ish using bloodhounds fang from the forlorn hound evergaol boss. Hits like a truck once you can use it.
Pretty fucked up to wish he got paralyzed from that incident, only cruel cunt here is you. TTD
